snippet.title: Câi & Darren: Code Calamity - Trailer
snippet.description:
At the MAD program, two top-tier college professors, Darren and Câi, are the ultimate coding duo! Darren is a master of the Swipe programming language, while Câi is a wizard of the Brew programming language. One day, just as Darren is about to start his morning lecture—BZZT!—every computer in the lab goes haywire! It's now up to both Câi and Darren to find out what's going on and put a stop to it!

Free on Itch.io:
https://cherrybomb-radical.itch.io/cai-darren-code-calamity
